era_envelope.default_vfx_ceiling_note: Raised from FX1 on 2026-09-19. Recovered packet S1.T1.B01.A1.E16 carries FX2 and the ruling is that the packet is correct - "start with a bang". The FX1 ceiling was the error.
era_envelope.default_vfx_ceiling_is_a_default_not_a_c: There is no trilogy fx_max. `default_vfx_ceiling` is a DEFAULT: the FX level to assume when nothing says otherwise. Exceeding it is NOT a breach and is not reported as one. The fx band derived from this trilogy's books is FX0-FX2, recorded here for reference only.

environment_envelope.derivation: Union of the three book envelopes beneath this trilogy (B01, B02, B03), each itself a union of its three act bands: min of mins, max of maxes, per axis. No judgement was applied to any value. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.
environment_envelope.soft_ceiling: SOFT. Ruled 2026-09-20, GATE_RULINGS_2026-09-20.md Ruling 5: a trilogy ceiling is a tripwire, not a wall. Specific events may run briefly over or under it, but every breach must be DECLARED in `exceptions` above. An undeclared breach is a violation; a declared one is a notice.
environment_envelope.supersedes: Replaces scalar weather_max/corridor_max, which read W3/U5 in all three trilogies alongside an unfilled TODO reading "Populate trilogy-specific ceilings and exceptions." They were SKELETON DEFAULTS, never populated - not author-set ceilings. Ledger section 57.
